title: Global satellite survey reveals uncertainty in landfill methane emissions — Nature
snippet: A Nature study presents the first comprehensive global satellite survey of methane emissions from landfills using Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data. The research reveals significant uncertainties in current landfill methane emission inventories, with satellite-observed emissions often 2-3x higher than reported. The study maps methane plumes from hundreds of landfill sites across 40+ countries, highlighting major discrepancies between reported and observed emissions. Findings have critical implications for national greenhouse gas inventories and climate policy under the Global Methane Pledge.
tag_reason: New peer-reviewed global landfill methane survey using Sentinel-5P TROPOMI. Directly relevant to Climate & Environment domain and methane plume monitoring category.
